manual_activity: Owner separately authorizes key provisioning, capsule update/activation and any unprovision; operator maintains hardware recovery while agent may collect state/task/boot evidence.

review_improvement: Restores the source's valid Root-of-Trust capsule-update coverage while retaining strong recovery controls and isolating destructive provisioning operations.
independent_technical_reasoning: PFR provisioning establishes trust anchors and may change an irreversible lifecycle, while capsule update exercises signature verification and activation. Unprovisioning is another distinct destructive transition. A negative corrupt/older image should be rejected and therefore cannot prove that an authorized capsule updates and boots. The case needs a precise AST1060 state machine, immutable key/capsule provenance, separate approvals and external recovery before any of the three mutations can be executed.
